info.title: wgs: Xbox Connected Storage command-line tool
info.description: Command-line tool for Game Pass (Xbox Connected Storage, "wgs") save folders: list containers, diagnose health, extract and replace blobs, take whole-folder backups, and fingerprint a store before and after a cloud sync.
